Players Committee card image of [[Palpatine, Emperor Returned]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a location with a [Light Side] icon. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, if about to be lost, may take him into hand. Immune to attrition.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
